title: Editable Feature — Editable Columns
description: Defines the logical fields that can be edited for a feature, keyed by stable logical field id. Each entry maps to one or more physical database columns. Used by the FYOD and Data Studio edit editors.

editableField.title: Editable Field
editableField.description: A single logical field exposed in the correction editor. The key is a stable logical field id (not necessarily a physical column name).

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the correction editor UI

order.description: Lexicographic sort key controlling the display order of fields in the editor. Use single letters (a, b, c) or fractional strings (a, am, b) to insert between siblings without renumbering.

description.description: Optional notes about this field — shown as help text in the editor or as a tooltip
examples: The legal owner of record as it appears on the deed

type.description: Value/control type (the `type` axis). Scalar: string, number, integer, boolean, date, enum. Geometry: position, multipoint, path, bounds. Omit for a read-only context field.

role.description: Optional semantic role, orthogonal to `type`. 'name' marks the display-name / record-list title field; 'address' marks the primary address field. Each role requires type 'string' and is used at most once per feature.

items.description: Physical column name — lowercase snake_case, matching the feature table's column

columns.description: Physical database column(s) this logical field corrects. Most fields map to one column; multi-column for composite fields such as position (lat + lng) or bounds (min_lat, max_lat, min_lng, max_lng).
